title: Arizona Residential Seller's Property Disclosure Statement
description: Arizona Revised Statutes §33-405 requires sellers of residential property to complete the AAR Residential Seller's Property Disclosure Statement (SPDS) before or at contract execution.

title: Affidavit of Property Value
description: Arizona requires an Affidavit of Property Value (DOR Form 82162) to be recorded with the deed for all sales of real property.

title: Community Property Spousal Consent
description: Arizona is a community property state. Both spouses must sign deeds conveying community property, even if only one spouse is on title.

required_actions.note: Both spouses must sign the deed and any deed of trust for community property.
